item.title: Tadej Pogacar will ride Vuelta a España in bid to complete Grand Tour treble
item.summary: Slovene great last rode in Vuelta during the 2019 edition ‘The time is right to go back,’ says five-time Tour winner Cycling great Tadej Pogacar will return to the Vuelta a España for the first time since 2019, UAE Team Emirates confirmed on Monday. “It’s true – he’s coming back,” wrote the five-time Tour de France winner’s team on social media platform X to announce his participation in the race, which starts on 22 August.
